pr_title: [API] add comments endpoint for single comment
pr_body:
close #9486
usefull at #4811 (#9488)

add `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}`

GitHub reference spec: [link](https://developer.github.com/v3/repos/comments/#get-a-single-commit-comment)

review_comments: Should we do a check that the comment ID belongs to specific repo?
@techknowlogick I'll add a check for securety concerns
I think we should check that the comment belongs to said repository at least. Otherwise, how can we be certain that the user has permission to access that comment?
The check should be a middleware on routes like we have did on other routes. I think this could be another PR.
This should also check whether the user has access to issues or PRs depending of whether the issue is a PR or not.

@guillep2k this use the same rights mechanism as `ListRepoIssueComments`

so it does not make sence to limit the `GET single comment` api if the `Get comments` still has it
if we decide to be more strict on how a user can access comments we should make a new PR wich handle this in generel
